updates.note: Management reiterated revenue growth guidance of 15-plus percent for FY27.
updates.quote: revenue growth of 15-plus percent, although there may be some positive surprises as you have predicted. But right now, we are confident we will have 15-plus.

updates.note: Management reiterated EBITDA margins of around 28% for FY27.
updates.quote: EBITDA margins of around 28%, the order inflow of INR25,000 crores minimum, excluding QRSAM

updates.note: Management reiterated order inflow expectations of more than INR 55,000 crores including QRSAM and INR 25,000 crores excluding QRSAM.
updates.quote: including QRSAM, INR50,000-plus crores... order inflow of INR25,000 crores minimum, excluding QRSAM

updates.note: Management reiterated R&D investment of INR 2,200-plus crores for FY27.
Management reiterated capex target of around INR 1,200 crores for FY27.
